summary.content:
Today's selection covers 75 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 47 on Artificial Intelligence and 13 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI encourages firms to trial four-day weeks to adapt to AI era
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Microsoft links Medusa ransomware affiliate to zero-day attacks
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, TechCrunch, The Verge, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 46 articles published in the last 24 hours
